summary: Increment #4b of the world-engine history program (GROUND track): a NEW three-free relief writer writeStagnantLidReliefSphere in src/worldengine/base/stagnantLid.js for the stagnant-lid silicate regime (Venus), a sibling of plates.js / shellRelief.js. It organizes relief about ONE seeded mantle-plume field (alea 'stagnant:' namespace) reproducing the BAT-region causal logic, and REPLACES carrier.height for Venus: tessera crustal plateaus (high, ~7-8%, orthogonal ribbon+fold double-fabric via two crossed steeredNoise3 ridged fields) over the oldest plume caps; coronae (60-2600 km heavy-tailed draw, placed field-biased not sprinkled, active=dome+trench+rise / inactive=rim+depression as an analytic radial-profile MORPHOLOGY SELECTOR, CORONA_ACTIVE_FRAC=0.65); a basaltic regional-plains datum (~70-80% TOTAL plains) with rift-corridor lows; plus a diagnostics-only resurfAge field. Dispatch predicate isStagnantLidPath goes in planet-lod-rivers.js next to isEarthlikePlatePath/isShellReliefPath (NOT base/), inserting stagnant-lid AFTER the shipped volcanic branch and BEFORE the despun fallback; ONE PRESET_ARCHETYPE line ('Venus (sulfuric shroud)':'stagnant-lid') routes Venus. Key-based match only (NOT gated on locked; Venus is locked:false). Pure BROADEN sibling: zero-clobbers plate/shell/volcanic/despun (checked before it, return first). No new carrier.regime constant (verify.js asserts {0,1,2}); no edits to plates.js/shellRelief.js/tectonic.js/sphereField.js/verify.js/planet-archetypes.js; no Math.random/Date.now/new-while; REPLACE via .set(U); bounded RELAX_PASSES Jacobi smooth. Citations re-verified 2026-07-01 (all calibration constants hold). Seed-only (driver-response deferred to a future 4b-MULTIPLY). Lab-only (#9 ports to game).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: DETERMINISM + NO-RNG: the writer is fully deterministic and RNG-free. Same macroSeed => byte-identical U / grainAngle / faultDensity / resurfAge / isTessera / coronaActive; no Math.random / Date.now / new convergence while-loop; every draw uses only the disjoint alea 'stagnant:' namespace (never sharing a stream with 'plates:'/'shell:'/'e6:'/'magma:'); |U| < STAGNANT_BOUND for all nodes.

verifyVia.input: Static-grep stagnantLid.js for /Math\.random|Date\.now/ and for any new while-loop; run writeStagnantLidReliefSphere twice on the same fresh 600-node carrier for seeds {1,2,3,7,42}; enumerate the alea seed strings used.
verifyVia.observable: Zero grep matches; byte-identical typed arrays (U/grainAngle/faultDensity/resurfAge/isTessera/coronaActive) across the two runs for every seed; every alea stream string is prefixed 'stagnant:'; |U[i]| < STAGNANT_BOUND for all nodes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: STRUCTURE BAR (must PASS): relief is organized BY the seeded plume field with the right Venus proportions and morphology. (a) coronae+tessera correlate with an arm's-length plume predictor rebuilt from published plumeCenters (varExplainedByPlume >= 0.5); (b) tesseraFrac in [0.06,0.10] AND plainsFrac in [0.65,0.85]; (c) elevation ordering mean(tessera) > mean(plains) > mean(active-plume/rift), where the LOW mask is scoped as {rift corridors} UNION {active-corona trench annulus 0.8<=rho<=1.05} — NOT the area-average of a whole active corona (its domed interior is above plains); (d) the active/inactive morphology SELECTOR is present; (e) activeFrac ~= CORONA_ACTIVE_FRAC (0.65) +/- 0.12.

verifyVia.input: Build the field per seed on a shared 600-node carrier; rebuild the plume-proximity predictor arm's-length from the published plumeCenters (independent of U); sample the correctly-scoped ordering masks; sample radial profiles at a set of active + inactive coronae.
verifyVia.observable: |corr(structureMask, plumePredictor)| >= 0.40 (CALIBRATED 2026-07-01: the binary ~17%-ones point-biserial makes r^2>=0.5 structurally unreachable, ceiling ~0.46 — mirrors the magmatism sibling's |corr| convention; the rigorous seed-robust falsifier is AC4 real>>control); tesseraFrac in [0.06,0.10]; plainsFrac in [0.65,0.85]; mean(tessera) > mean(plains) > mean(trench/rift lows); at active coronae coronaContrib(rho<0.5)>0 & coronaContrib(0.8<=rho<=1.05)<0, at inactive coronaContrib(rho<0.5)<0 & coronaContrib(0.85<=rho<=1.05)>0; activeFrac within 0.65 +/- 0.12; all seeds. Structure test runs at N=1500 (finer than the siblings' 600 — stagnant-lid's many small coronae need the resolution).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: LATITUDE CONTROL (must FAIL) — the load-bearing falsifier: Venus does NOT fall to sin^2(lat). U is not explained by latitude — varExplainedByLatitude < 0.15 AND < varExplainedByPlume, for every seed. Tessera/coronae are plume-scattered, not banded.

verifyVia.input: Correlate U vs sin^2(carrier latitude about +y) per seed; compare to varExplainedByPlume from AC2.
verifyVia.observable: varExplainedByLatitude < 0.15 AND varExplainedByLatitude < varExplainedByPlume, all seeds.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: RANDOM-PLACEMENT CONTROL (must FAIL) — the anti-tautology guard: a writer variant that places coronae+tessera by pure RNG (constant accept-gate; tessera thresholded on an INDEPENDENT noise field; ignoring plumeProx) must FAIL the structure bar, proving the real placement is causally plume-organized, not sprinkled.

verifyVia.input: Run the random-placement control variant on the same seeds; recompute |corr(structureMask, plumePredictor)| with the same arm's-length predictor.
verifyVia.observable: For the control, |corr| collapses < 0.15 while the real writer has |corr| >= 0.40 AND > 2x the control, on the same seeds (real-beats-control by a decisive margin is the causal, seed-robust proof that placement is plume-organized, not sprinkled).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: VARIETY (distinct-per-world): two seeds produce different plumeCount AND different coronaCount AND a visibly different tessera pattern (< 0.2 node-overlap of isTessera), each reproducible per seed.

verifyVia.input: Build the field at two seeds; compare plumeCount, coronaCount, and the isTessera node-overlap fraction.
verifyVia.observable: plumeCount differs AND coronaCount differs across the two seeds; isTessera node-overlap < 0.2; each seed's field reproducible on re-run.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: NO-CLOBBER (plate / shell / volcanic / despun) + scope guard: routing terrestrial/ocean (plate), Europa (shell), a volcanic body (volcanic), and a gas-giant-unlocked (despun) through writeBodyRelief returns each prior path byte-identical with stagnantDiag null; carrier.regime untouched (verify.js regime in {0,1,2} — no 4th regime constant); the commit diff touches ONLY the in-scope files.

verifyVia.input: Call writeBodyRelief with terrestrial/ocean, ice (Europa), a volcanic preset, and gas-giant unlocked; compare returned fields to captured pre-change baselines; run the plate/shell/volcanic regime-gate suites; git show the commit.
verifyVia.observable: plate/shell/volcanic/despun U byte-identical to baseline with stagnantDiag null off the stagnant path; the regime-gate suites pass; carrier.regime stays in {0,1,2}; git diff touches ONLY stagnantLid.js (new), planet-lod-rivers.js, world-engine-lab.html, the new stagnant test file, and workstream docs — NOT plates.js / shellRelief.js / tectonic.js / sphereField.js / verify.js / planet-archetypes.js.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: SEAM FIRES + single-coverage fragility (key-based, not locked-gated): WITH the one PRESET_ARCHETYPE line ('Venus (sulfuric shroud)':'stagnant-lid'), Venus routes to path 'stagnant-lid' (regime 'venus-stagnant-lid') and does NOT fall to sin^2; WITHOUT the line, Venus (archetype=null, locked:false) has NO fallback net and routes to 'despun' — documenting the fragility (the contract KEEPS the line). Dispatch is key-based only; it must fire regardless of the locked flag.

verifyVia.input: Resolve the Venus preset with and without the PRESET_ARCHETYPE line; call stagnantLidRegimeOf/isStagnantLidPath on 'stagnant-lid' (both locked=false and locked=true) and on (null, locked=false).
verifyVia.observable: With the line -> path 'stagnant-lid', regime 'venus-stagnant-lid', not 'despun'; without the line -> path 'despun'; stagnantLidRegimeOf('stagnant-lid') === 'venus-stagnant-lid' for locked=false AND locked=true; stagnantLidRegimeOf(null) === null.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: LIVE PROBE: in the running lab, selecting Venus with reliefBakeStrength(1) renders tessera plateaus + corona rings + basaltic plains (NOT sin^2 bands), and stagnantLidProbe() confirms the field is real and plume-organized. Agent-verified via chrome-devtools (objective) — not asked of Max.

verifyVia.input: chrome-devtools on the lab (list_pages for liveness per sandbox-localhost-probe), select 'Venus (sulfuric shroud)', setSeed(1234), reliefBakeStrength(1), force a route, call stagnantLidProbe(), take a screenshot.
verifyVia.observable: heightSource == 'carrier', regime == 'venus-stagnant-lid'; varExplainedByPlume > varExplainedByLatitude; ordering meanTessera > meanPlains > meanRiftTrench; tesseraFrac in [0.06,0.10], plainsFrac in [0.65,0.85], activeFrac ~= 0.65 +/- 0.12; the screenshot shows plume-scattered tessera + corona rings + plains with NO latitude banding.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: UAT (Max-only, holistic): does Venus read as a distinct, recognizably-Venus world from the user's view — tessera highlands, corona rings, a young plains sea — rather than the old latitude-band smear? Holistic acceptance; never PASSed by any agent (deferred-to-max).

verifyVia.observable: Max judges Venus as a distinct, recognizably-Venus world (not a latitude-band smear). Deferred-to-max — VERIFIED_PENDING_MAX <sha> on integration green, then Max UAT -> Shipped.
